implementation: Retain immutable-by-API raw callback baselines for the first import generation. Account all seven dynamic texture filenames in typed callback admission and export planning, including inactive fields. Extract existing body validation/serialization into one internal stateless codec shared by dxfRW and the facade. Decode immutable and current raw values separately from the mutable typed model with the owning MATERIAL parser, using a bounded temporary token transport in the original captured wire format and unsigned-color mode. This is not an independent parser implementation. Independently assigned contextual role keys distinguish base, normal, procedural and post-table code reuse. Compose disjoint edits and equal dual edits; refuse same-field value/presence conflicts.

Rewrite only changed represented slots, including presence insertion/removal, retaining other raw groups and ASCII spellings. Use canonical unsigned INTEGER64 carriers for changed colors, retain literal UTF-8/escape-looking text, and compare floating-point bits so signed-zero edits are not ignored. Preserve exact unchanged raw replay for opaque procedural tails/extension subclasses without claiming to understand them. Refuse body edits whose profiles are not represented. Require an explicit normal-block boundary for reused normal fields and retain the procedural-end guard; do not fabricate defaults to serialize an incomplete model. The selected luminance-removal and table-end-removal cases refuse. Alternate465-only mode/method ordering and broader source/schema/presence transactions remain open.
